tools.name: use_skill
tools.description: Read the instructions of one of the skills attached to you, by the name your system message lists it under. Call it when a request fits a skill, before you start the work, and follow what it returns.

tools.name: routines
tools.description: List, make, edit, delete and run this Bot's routines when you ask in chat. Deleting one always asks you first.

tools.name: list_routines
tools.description: List this Bot's routines: each one's id, name, the Bot it wakes, its prompt, whether it is on, when it wakes (a 5-field cron), the time zone that is read in, and nextDueMs (epoch milliseconds). Only this Bot's own are listed, never your person's other Bots': an empty list means this Bot has none, not that your person has none. Webhook keys and addresses are never listed.
tools.label: List routines
tools.summary: Lists this Bot's routines.

tools.name: create_routine
tools.description: Make a routine: this Bot is woken on a schedule and told its prompt, with nobody watching. A routine is always this Bot's own; it cannot be made for another Bot. `when` is REQUIRED and is never guessed: if the person has not said both the time and the days, call request_user_form first with a field for each, then make it with what they answer. A routine wakes at most once a minute.
tools.label: Create routine
tools.summary: Makes a routine that wakes this Bot on a schedule.

tools.name: update_routine
tools.description: Change one of this Bot's routines, by its id from list_routines: only what you pass changes. `when` replaces its schedule; `active` false pauses it, true wakes it.
tools.label: Update routine
tools.summary: Changes one of this Bot's routines.

tools.name: delete_routine
tools.description: Delete one of this Bot's routines for good, by its id from list_routines. It always asks the person first, naming the routine.
tools.label: Delete routine
tools.summary: Deletes one of this Bot's routines for good.

tools.name: run_routine
tools.description: Run one of this Bot's routines now, as the person's Run now does, by its id or its name from list_routines: this Bot is woken with the routine's prompt, on the routine's own thread, and you are told the run's id. A paused routine, or one whose plan cannot answer now, is refused in words.
tools.label: Run routine
tools.summary: Runs one of this Bot's routines now.

tools.label: Routines
tools.summary: Lists, makes, edits, deletes and runs this Bot's routines.

tools.name: plugins
tools.description: Find, install and remove plugins, add and manage their accounts, and switch them on for your Bots when you ask in chat. Uninstalling, removing an account, or changing another Bot always asks you first.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List the plugins your person can use: each one's name, what it does, its category, whether it is installed, and for an installed one whether it is on for this Bot. `filter` is installed, available or all; `query` matches names and descriptions.
tools.label: List plugins
tools.summary: Lists the plugins you can use.

tools.name: plugin_details
tools.description: One plugin in full: its skills, tools and apps, the services it needs an account for, the accounts your person has for it, and which of their Bots have it on.
tools.label: Plugin details
tools.summary: Reads one plugin in full.

tools.name: install_plugin
tools.description: Install a plugin for your person, at the registry's current version. Installing switches it on for no Bot and adds no account: say so, and offer the next step.
tools.label: Install plugin
tools.summary: Installs a plugin for you.

tools.name: uninstall_plugin
tools.description: Uninstall one of your person's plugins. Its accounts are removed with it. It always asks the person first.
tools.label: Uninstall plugin
tools.summary: Uninstalls one of your plugins and its accounts.

tools.name: list_plugin_accounts
tools.description: List your person's plugin accounts: each one's id, label, plugin, service, whether it is connected or needs sign-in, and which Bots use it. Never a key.
tools.label: List accounts
tools.summary: Lists your plugin accounts.

tools.name: add_plugin_account
tools.description: Add an account for an installed plugin: the person is shown a card in chat to sign in at the service, or to paste a key into a field that keeps it out of chat. Never ask for a key or password in chat, and never sign in through your computer. After calling it, tell the person the card is waiting and stop.
tools.label: Add account
tools.summary: Shows you a card to add a plugin account.

tools.name: rename_plugin_account
tools.description: Rename one of your person's plugin accounts, by its id from list_plugin_accounts.
tools.label: Rename account
tools.summary: Renames one of your plugin accounts.

tools.name: remove_plugin_account
tools.description: Remove one of your person's plugin accounts for good, by its id from list_plugin_accounts. Bots that used it lose it. It always asks the person first.
tools.label: Remove account
tools.summary: Removes one of your plugin accounts for good.

tools.name: set_plugin_for_bot
tools.description: Switch an installed plugin on or off for this Bot, or for another of your person's Bots named by `bot`, ONLY when the person asked for that switch in this conversation. Never switch one on to get a job done: a plugin that is off is the person's choice, and they use it for one message by tagging @name. Another Bot always asks first.
tools.label: Switch plugin for a Bot
tools.summary: Switches a plugin on or off for a Bot.

tools.name: pick_plugin_account
tools.description: Choose which of your person's accounts a Bot uses for a plugin's service, by its id from list_plugin_accounts, or ask_each_time true to clear the choice, ONLY when the person asked for that choice. This Bot unless `bot` names another of theirs, which always asks the person first.
tools.label: Pick account for a Bot
tools.summary: Chooses which account a Bot uses for a plugin.

tools.label: Plugins
tools.summary: Finds, installs and removes plugins and manages their accounts.

tools.name: manage_computer
tools.description: Check, start, shut down, restart, reset and update this Bot's own computer, look at your other Bots' screens, and set what it may reach on the network, when you ask in chat. Resetting, updating and the network setting always ask you first.

tools.name: computer_status
tools.description: Read THIS BOT'S OWN computer's state: whether it is running, starting, stopped or updating, whether its screen is up, and its network setting.
tools.label: Computer status
tools.summary: Reads whether the Bot's computer is running.

tools.name: look_at_screen
tools.description: See a picture of ANOTHER of the person's Bots' screens, named by its name or id (bot). Each Bot on a shared computer works on a screen of its own; use this to see what another Bot has open or how far it got. It only looks: it cannot click or type on that screen.
tools.label: Look at another Bot's screen
tools.summary: Shows the Bot a picture of another of your Bots' screens, without touching it.

tools.name: start_computer
tools.description: Start THIS BOT'S OWN computer when it is stopped. Its files are kept.
tools.label: Start computer
tools.summary: Starts the Bot's computer.

tools.name: shutdown_computer
tools.description: Shut down THIS BOT'S OWN computer. Its files are kept, and it starts again on the next turn that needs it or when start_computer is called.
tools.label: Shut down computer
tools.summary: Shuts the Bot's computer down, keeping its files.

tools.name: restart_computer
tools.description: Restart THIS BOT'S OWN computer: shut it down and start it again. Its files are kept.
tools.label: Restart computer
tools.summary: Restarts the Bot's computer.

tools.name: reset_computer
tools.description: Reset THIS BOT'S OWN computer to a fresh one: everything on it is deleted for good. It always asks the person first.
tools.label: Reset computer
tools.summary: Deletes everything on the Bot's computer for good.

tools.name: update_computer
tools.description: Update THIS BOT'S OWN computer to the newest image, keeping its files; it is rebuilt and is unavailable meanwhile. It always asks the person first.
tools.label: Update computer
tools.summary: Rebuilds the Bot's computer on the newest image.

tools.name: set_network
tools.description: Set what THIS BOT'S OWN computer may reach through the person's network: always, ask each time, or never. It always asks the person first.
tools.label: Set network
tools.summary: Sets what the Bot's computer may reach on your network.

tools.label: Manage computer
tools.summary: Checks, starts, stops, restarts, resets and updates the Bot's own computer, and looks at your other Bots' screens.

tools.name: office
tools.description: Create, read, search, edit and export .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files on this Bot's own computer, as proposals you can review before they are written.

tools.name: office_files
tools.description: List DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files and subdirectories under a directory on THIS BOT'S OWN computer (defaults to ~/office), plus open document IDs. Start here when the path is unknown.
tools.label: Browse documents
tools.summary: Lists the .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files on the Bot's computer.

tools.name: office_open
tools.description: Open an Office file on this Bot's computer and return its document ID, format, and capabilities.
tools.label: Open document
tools.summary: Opens an Office file and keeps a session you can watch live.

tools.name: office_create
tools.description: Create a NEW .docx, .xlsx, or .pptx on this Bot's computer; existing files are never overwritten. A new path is a new document with its own history — to REVISE a file, open it and use office_propose + office_accept instead: the same path updates in place and becomes the next version of the SAME document, which is what the person sees in their version history. Format comes from the path extension and requires the matching payload: docx.paragraphs [{text, style: title|heading1|heading2|normal, bold, italic}]; xlsx.rows string[][] of raw inputs ("42" number, "=SUM(A1:A3)" formula, other text); pptx.slides [{title, bullets: string[], notes}]. The parent directory must exist.
tools.label: Create document
tools.summary: Makes a new .docx, .xlsx or .pptx file on the Bot's computer.

tools.name: office_outline
tools.description: List DOCX paragraphs, PPTX slide paragraphs, or XLSX sheets (sheetId and name). Filter story; headingsOnly is DOCX-only. Paginate with nextOffset.
tools.label: Document outline
tools.summary: Reads a document's headings, sheets or slides.

tools.name: office_grep
tools.description: Find literal text with bounded context. DOCX/PPTX return match IDs for office_propose; XLSX returns cell handles for office_propose_cells, searching displayed values case-sensitively. story filters a DOCX/PPTX story or XLSX sheetId. Follow nextCursor; if truncated remains true, narrow query or story.
tools.label: Search document
tools.summary: Finds text inside an open document.

tools.name: office_read
tools.description: Read a ref from outline/grep/cells: a DOCX/PPTX paragraph or XLSX cell display text. Default 4000 UTF-16 units; follow nextStart. field selects displayText (default), formula, or value for XLSX.
tools.label: Read document
tools.summary: Reads a span of an open document's text.

tools.name: office_cells
tools.description: XLSX only: read a rectangular A1 range on a sheetId from office_outline. Includes empty cells, inputs, formula flags, and cell handles. Follow nextOffset.
tools.label: Read cells
tools.summary: Reads a range of a spreadsheet's cells.

tools.name: office_render
tools.description: Render a page as PNG using the document engine. page is one-based: a DOCX page, a PPTX slide, or an XLSX sheet index. Supply proposal to see its proposed result without changing the live document. Returns pageCount where the format has pages.
tools.label: Render page
tools.summary: Rasterizes one page, slide or sheet to an image.

tools.name: office_verify
tools.description: Save and reopen the current document or a pending proposal in memory. Reports completed checks explicitly; does not assert semantic or visual correctness.
tools.label: Verify document
tools.summary: Saves and reopens a document to prove the file is still valid.

tools.name: office_close
tools.description: Release an open document and its proposals. Export any work you want to keep first.
tools.label: Close document
tools.summary: Ends an open document's session.

tools.name: office_propose
tools.description: DOCX/PPTX: stage 1-32 text replacements without changing the document. XLSX uses office_propose_cells. First grep for the exact text you want to replace, then copy the desired occurrence's match ID. Supply edits [{match: ID_FROM_GREP, newText: REPLACEMENT}]. To change part of a sentence, grep that part; do not reuse a match for the whole sentence. New text inherits formatting at its start. No paragraph/embedded-content/tracked-change crossings.
tools.label: Propose edits
tools.summary: Stages text edits you can review before they are written.

tools.name: office_propose_cells
tools.description: XLSX only: stage 1-32 whole-cell inputs using cell handles copied from office_cells, office_read, or office_grep. input is what a user types: 123 for a number, =SUM(A1:A3) for a formula, or text. Empty input clears a cell. Review before accepting/exporting.
tools.label: Propose cell edits
tools.summary: Stages spreadsheet edits you can review before they are written.

tools.name: office_review
tools.description: List proposals, or supply proposal to inspect exact before/after changes, attribution, status, and staleness. A stale proposal must be re-created from fresh reads.
tools.label: Review proposals
tools.summary: Shows what a staged edit would change.

tools.name: office_accept
tools.description: Apply a proposal to the open document atomically and write the file back — the SAME path now holds the next version; no new file is made. Stale targets are rejected. Export afterwards to hand the person a copy.
tools.label: Accept edits
tools.summary: Writes a reviewed proposal to the document.

tools.name: office_reject
tools.description: Discard a pending proposal without editing the document.
tools.label: Reject edits
tools.summary: Discards a staged proposal without writing.

tools.name: office_export
tools.description: Write a file of the opened format (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) on this Bot's computer and attach it to your reply for the person — a copy: editing continues on the open document, not the copy. Existing files are never overwritten except a path this session itself exported before, so re-shipping the latest state keeps the same filename instead of inventing -v2 copies. Supply proposal to export a proposed result without accepting it; omit proposal to export accepted edits.
tools.label: Export document
tools.summary: Saves the document to a new file and attaches it to the reply.

tools.label: Office documents
tools.summary: Create, read, search, edit and export .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files on this Bot's own computer, as proposals you can review before they are written.
